entries.title: Civic Wire made fully manageable and source-aware
entries.summary: Editorial Studio now presents the complete live Civic Wire hierarchy, a manual Notice Library, and a Source Manager for built-in and custom RSS or Atom sources. Founder-authorized controls support editing, scheduling, ordering, visual treatments, pausing, archiving, restoring, refreshing, and suppressing individual feed items. Every human content or settings change appends an actor-attributed Transparency Ledger event from the authenticated civic identity, including archival, while automatic source refreshes remain quiet. External feeds are restricted to public HTTPS endpoints, bounded, sanitized, and cached in Cloudflare D1. All 73 release tests passed before publication.
entries.subjectName: Managed Civic Wire and Source Manager

metadata.ledgerAttribution: Authenticated civic identity for every human ticker change
metadata.automaticRefreshPolicy: Source refreshes update cached content without ledger noise
changes: Added a Current Civic Wire table showing the exact public rotation hierarchy
Added a Notice Library for creating, editing, scheduling, pausing, archiving, and restoring manual notices
Added a Source Manager for built-in sources and custom RSS or Atom feeds
Added priority ranks, within-rank ordering, destinations, and accessible visual treatments
Added source health, refresh controls, and suppression or restoration of individual feed items
Attributed every human ticker mutation and archival event to the authenticated civic identity in the Transparency Ledger
Kept automatic feed refreshes out of the ledger to avoid repetitive machine-generated entries
Restricted custom feeds to bounded and sanitized public HTTPS retrieval with D1 caching
